vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: Specify the required team id that a user must belong to in order to use Cursor. If set and the signed-in user is not part of the team, Cursor will automatically sign the user out.
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 指定用户必须所属的团队 ID 才能使用 Cursor。若已设置且登录用户不属于该团队，Cursor 会自动将其退出登录。

vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: Comma-separated list of Cursor organization ids whose members are allowed to sign in on this device (set via device management).
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 允许在此设备登录的 Cursor 组织 ID 逗号分隔列表（通过设备管理设置）。

vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: When enabled via device management (MDM), Cursor's backend refuses to issue or refresh sign-in sessions for accounts that match none of the configured allowed organizations, teams, emails, or email domains.
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 通过设备管理 (MDM) 启用后，若账号与已配置的允许组织、团队、邮箱或邮箱域均不匹配，Cursor 后端将拒绝签发或刷新登录会话。

vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: Comma-separated list of Cursor team ids whose members are allowed to sign in on this device (set via device management). Supersedes the singular AllowedTeamId policy; both are honored.
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 允许在此设备登录的 Cursor 团队 ID 逗号分隔列表（通过设备管理设置）。优先于单独的 AllowedTeamId 策略；两者都会生效。

vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: Comma-separated list of exact account emails allowed to sign in on this device (set via device management). Compared case-insensitively.
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 允许在此设备登录的精确账号邮箱逗号分隔列表（通过设备管理设置）。比较时不区分大小写。

vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.source: Comma-separated list of email domains (e.g. example.com) whose accounts are allowed to sign in on this device (set via device management). Exact domain match only; subdomains are not implicitly included.
vs/workbench/services/cursorAuth/browser.translation: 允许在此设备登录的邮箱域逗号分隔列表（例如 example.com，通过设备管理设置）。仅精确匹配域名，不会隐式包含子域。
